requirements.text: verify if they're linked to that knowledge article. For any incidents missing the link, add it
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 'KB_001' AND incident_id IN ('INC_010', 'INC_041', 'INC_059', 'INC_078', 'INC_085', 'INC_091', 'INC_100') AND used_as = 'resolution'
assumptions: the seven password-reset incidents since 1 November 2025 that already have a KB_001 link are outside 'incidents missing the link'
each keeps exactly its one KB_001 link with usage 'resolution': no duplicate link and no change to the existing one

disagreement: requirement present in one pass only; kept because the request limits the additions to incidents missing the link, and these seven are the rows a loose reading (link every password incident) would sweep in

requirements.text: Check all password-related incidents created since November 1st, 2025
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 'KB_001' AND incident_id IN ('INC_007', 'INC_009', 'INC_082')
assumptions: password-related means category password-reset; every incident titled Password Reset is in that category

INC_007 (Account Locked Out, AD account unlocked, linked to KB_004 Lockout Rules), INC_009 (MFA Token Reset, linked to KB_002) and INC_082 (SAP Login Fail, error 503) are not password incidents and gain no KB_001 link

disagreement: selector: A every incident outside category password-reset (INC_049 among them), B INC_007 and INC_082 only; chose INC_007, INC_009 and INC_082 because they are the near misses a loose reading would sweep in, while INC_049 (Locked Out, 'Reset needed.', unresolved) may be a password reset and so cannot be forbidden the link

notes:
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that the seven password-reset incidents already linked to KB_001 (INC_010, INC_041, INC_059, INC_078, INC_085, INC_091, INC_100) keep exactly one KB_001 link with usage 'resolution'; one pass has it, the other does not; kept because the request adds links only where they are missing, so these seven bound that set and a duplicate or a changed usage would show only here.
disagreement: value: the selector of the stay on incidents that are not password-related: one pass every incident outside category password-reset (including INC_049), the other INC_007 and INC_082; chose INC_007, INC_009 and INC_082, the near misses a loose reading would sweep in, because INC_049 (Locked Out, 'Reset needed.', in progress) may be a password reset and is left untested either way.
The seed holds 17 password-reset incidents, all created between 2025-11-01 and 2025-12-01, so the date bound excludes none of them. Seven already link KB_001 as resolution; the other ten each need one new link, which is exactly the set the benchmark checks name. All ten are resolved or closed with resolution code 'Solution Provided', so the condition 'if the article helped solve the issue' is taken as met for each. INC_081 also holds a suggested link to KB_014, which the request does not touch.
The new links' org_id is not tested: neither the request nor the policy fixes it, and the existing KB_001 links carry the incident's own organisation. The acting user, Karen Watkins, holds the admin role, so may create the links.
